# Synthetic Event Media fixtures

All files are generated test patterns. None contains Guest or Client photos.

Generated locally with the ffmpeg 6.1.1 binary distributed by pinned
`ffmpeg-static@5.3.0`, installed only under `/private/tmp/event-media-fixtures`.
This is fixture tooling, not an application dependency. Commands use lavfi:

- `avc-audio.mp4`: 32×32 teal, 2 fps, two seconds; H.264 (`libx264`, yuv420p),
  440 Hz synthetic sine AAC audio, `-movflags +faststart`.
- `avc-30s.mp4`: 32×32 teal, 1 fps, exactly thirty seconds; H.264, yuv420p,
  `-movflags +faststart`.
- `avc-fragmented-31s.mp4`: same color/rate, thirty-one seconds; H.264,
  `-movflags +frag_keyframe+empty_moov`, to exercise duration beyond initial moov.
- `avc-fragmented-2s.mp4`: same teal source, two seconds, `-bf 0`, H.264,
  `-movflags +frag_keyframe+empty_moov`; valid fragmented acceptance.
- `avc-quicktime.mov`: stream-copy remux of `avc-audio.mp4` using `-f mov`;
  verifies that AVC codec alone does not establish the required MP4 container.
- `hevc.mp4`: 32×32 teal, 1 fps, two seconds; `libx265`, hvc1 sample entry.
- `animated.png`: 16×16 `testsrc`, 2 fps, two frames; `-plays 0 -f apng`.
- `animated.webp`: same test source/timing, two frames, `-loop 0`.

Still PNG/JPEG/WebP fixtures are generated by sharp in tests. The shared
`tests/fixtures/event-media.ts` pads PNG with a valid CRC-protected tEXt chunk
and MP4 with a `free` box to test exact 10,000,000/50,000,000-byte transfers.
Near-limit files are generated during tests rather than checked into Git.
Malformed variants are copied/truncated or have specific container fields
changed in tests; originals remain valid fixtures.

Video validation uses MP4Box parsing, sample descriptions/configuration,
complete sample extents/extraction, and presentation timing. It is not a full
H.264 pixel decoder or physical iPad playback qualification. Image validation
uses sharp metadata followed by actual decoding.
